notification_topic.description: The name of the notification topic to be subscribed, used to define the subscription target.
notification_topic.x-a2at-value-constraint: The specific topic name can be: Incident, Fault, intelligent fault, fault, etc.

subscribe_condition.description: The condition description to be subscribed, used to define subscription constraints such as fault name and fault severity.
examples: Fault priority: critical, high. Fault name: fiber break, board fault.
Fault priority: high, medium. Fault name: board fault, main control board abnormal, port abnormal.
subscribe_condition.x-a2at-value-constraint: The subscription condition may include fault priority and fault name. Fault priority supports a list form. Priority semantics support synonymous Chinese/English expressions; a match on either the Chinese or English term is considered valid: urgent/critical, high/high, medium/medium, low/low. Fault name supports a list form, with allowed values being the list of network-side fault names, for example: pigtail fault, fiber break, board fault, optical module fault, etc.

notification_data_format.description: The notification data format description to be reported, used to define the data type and carrying format.
notification_data_format.x-a2at-value-constraint: May describe the reported data type and carrying Part. The data type can be Incident, fault, etc.; the carrying format can be an A2A Part, such as DataPart or TextPart.
